caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical tin container with a domed lid and a metal handle on top. The tin is painted with a dark brown base color, and it features decorative patterns in multiple colors. There is a yellow-green vine pattern along the upper edge of the container, just below the rim of the lid. On the body of the tin, there are floral motifs in red and orange with green and yellow leaves, as well as a stylized bird in shades of green, white, and salmon pink. The flowers and bird are arranged in a symmetrical composition, filling the available surface area. The illustration includes details showing the metallic texture, some worn areas on the tin, and a rectangular latch in the center. The drawing is bordered by a plain, off-white background. The artist’s signature, “MARIE FANOLLARD,” is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Canister
